scientific_integrity: Construction and cardinality explicitly credited to previous papers; only exhaustive classification and resulting uniqueness consequences claimed. Two different finite verification algorithms corroborate the all-orders symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: All-orders theorem specific to GP(n,2). Earlier 2024 work already gives existence and size of the periodic dominating induced matching. The 2018 Yang-Wu full article was inaccessible, so possible prior equivalent uniqueness statements remain unexcluded. Independent external validation and publication priority not certified.
title: Rigidity of efficient edge domination in generalized Petersen graphs \(GP(n,2)\)
